exercises.question: Which sentence expresses purpose? [¿Cuál expresa finalidad?]
options: Estudiamos para mejorar nuestro español. [We study in order to improve our Spanish.]
Estudiamos porque tenemos tiempo. [We study because we have time.]
Estudiamos; por eso mejoramos. [We study; therefore we improve.]

exercises.sentence: Estudiamos ___ mejorar nuestro español. (para) [We study in order to improve our Spanish.]

exercises.english: We left early so that there would be no problems.

sentences: Queremos mejorar el servicio. [We want to improve the service.]
Organizamos una reunión. [We organise a meeting.]
Organizamos una reunión para mejorar el servicio. [We organise a meeting to improve the service.]

exercises.question: Which word means «objective»? [¿Qué palabra significa «objetivo»?]
options: objetivo [objective]
resultado [result]
causa [cause]

exercises.sentence: El ___ del proyecto es mejorar el transporte. (objetivo) [The objective of the project is to improve transport.]

exercises.english: We work to achieve a good result.

options: We study in order to improve our Spanish.
We study because our Spanish is already perfect.
We study, so our Spanish was improved yesterday.

exercises.sentence: Salimos temprano para que no hubiera problemas.
options: We left early so that there would be no problems.
We left late because there were no problems.
We left early despite the problems.

exercises.sentence: Trabajamos para lograr un buen resultado.

options: Para mejorar el servicio. [To improve the service.]
Por eso el servicio. [Therefore the service.]
Aunque el servicio. [Although the service.]
El objetivo es lograr un buen resultado. [The objective is to achieve a good result.]
El objetivo es ayer. [The objective is yesterday.]
El resultado es para que. [The result is so that.]
Para que no hubiera problemas. [So that there would be no problems.]
Sin embargo, había problemas. [However, there were problems.]
Por lo tanto, temprano. [Therefore, early.]

template.prompt: Explain the purpose of an action.
State the objective of a project.
template.answer: El objetivo del proyecto es mejorar el transporte.

template.prompt: Use para que to explain a purpose involving another subject.
template.answer: Organizamos la reunión para que todos pudieran participar.
